reading_scope: Primary-paper relevant sections and author repository README. Not a full reproduction, exhaustive literature search, complete appendix review or verified visual replot.

source_matrix.title: How Memory Management Impacts LLM Agents: An Empirical Study of Experience-Following Behavior
source_matrix.facts: Studies episodic query/execution demonstrations, addition and deletion. History-based deletion uses downstream utility after repeated retrieval. Its RegAgent strict filter still permits error up to one; misaligned replay includes both task/context mismatch and evaluator error. An error-free retrieval comparison is also present, so the work cannot be dismissed as exclusively noisy-memory research.
source_matrix.correction_to_prior_shorthand: Evaluator-approved history is not necessarily an exactly correct stored computation. Conversely, the paper already discusses misalignment and error-free comparisons: exact cache provenance alone does not establish novelty.
source_matrix.unverified: No tested equivalence between their memory interventions and our availability/price intervention; no new performance numbers imported.

source_matrix.title: CostBench: Evaluating Multi-Turn Cost-Optimal Planning and Adaptation in Dynamic Environments for LLM Tool-Use Agents
source_matrix.facts: Atomic/composite tools offer alternative routes; cost and availability can change while goals remain reachable. Acquired data remain accessible. Appendix B.3.2 excludes non-goal-reaching trajectories from cost/path and task-completion metrics; invalid calls are excluded from cost/path calculations, while invalid-tool-use includes all outcomes.
source_matrix.our_inference: Correct cheaper routes and tool-choice sensitivity are already covered. Their conditional metric denominators should not be silently reused as unconditional end-to-end success or actual expenditure in our experiment.
source_matrix.unverified: No direct implementation replication or claim that our proposed interpretation effect is absent from all related work.

source_matrix.title: Agent Memory Management author repository
source_matrix.facts: README limits the release to AgentDriver experiments and provides patches requiring the upstream Agent-Driver project and its data. This is not an immediately executable release of all four paper agents.
source_matrix.our_inference: Borrow the experimental distinction as related work, not an unverified ready-made SQL baseline. Verify licenses, source revision and data requirements before any implementation reuse.

evidence_reconciliation.negative_control_fact: One clarified task pair, four dependent conditions, all correct via identical recomputation; no cache reads. No observed first-action/correctness availability or price contrast on this case.
evidence_reconciliation.positive_control_fact: One correct completed recomputation and three invalid first outputs. These are not three semantic errors, nor evidence that every condition chose recomputation.
evidence_reconciliation.interpretation: We have neither demonstrated selective beneficial reuse under the symmetric interface nor a remaining task-interpretation gap after strong baselines. Literature distinctions sharpen the hypothesis but do not supply the missing empirical effect.

prospective_measurement_gate_not_a_froze.principle: Report practical end-to-end outcomes and conditional diagnostics separately; preserve every planned slot and every incurred call.
prospective_measurement_gate_not_a_froze.completed_correct_fraction: Correct completed slots divided by planned slots is an operational completion measure, not a semantic-error rate; provide the full disposition vector alongside it.
prospective_measurement_gate_not_a_froze.conditional_answer_correctness: If also reported, state the explicit valid-and-gradable-answer denominator and never substitute it for all-slot completion.
prospective_measurement_gate_not_a_froze.cost: Retain all actual model charges or conservative accounting and all tool attempts, including failed attempts. Separate declared tool units from currency and invoice-verified costs from client estimates.
prospective_measurement_gate_not_a_froze.descriptive_invalid_rate: Invalid model outputs divided by observed model-response slots; independently report missing and infrastructure-failed slots. Do not classify missing responses as malformed content.
prospective_measurement_gate_not_a_froze.paired_effects: Predefine task-level paired endpoints and incomplete-pair policy before a confirmation study. Dependent conditions/calls are not independent tasks. The current stopped-batch policy forbids successful-prefix treatment-effect claims.
prospective_measurement_gate_not_a_froze.C_type_endpoint: Requires observable prior task interpretation inconsistent with the reviewed request plus genuinely later behavior consistent with that interpretation. A wrong answer, cost-suboptimal route, or malformed action is insufficient.
prospective_measurement_gate_not_a_froze.diagnostic_intervention: Contract elicitation changes the workflow. Keep elicited-contract diagnostics distinct from ordinary-agent behavior and compare safeguards with fair information and total costs.
prospective_measurement_gate_not_a_froze.method_gate: First show a task-fidelity/total-cost gap after direct recomputation, contract-first, independent verification and trusted applicability/recompute baselines; do not name a method merely for rejecting lossy views.
